scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/game-engine -w packages/protocol && npm run build -w packages/server -w packages/ai-game-sim -w packages/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/game-engine/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ai-game-sim/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli-client/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/client/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify:python: npm run lint:python && npm run test:python
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:python
